title: Set Up Your Salon for the First Time
summary: Complete the essential settings your salon needs to accept appointments, serve customers, and take payments.
htmlContent:
Complete these essential settings before your salon starts serving customers with NEXORA TOUCH.

Before you start

Prepare your salon information, business hours, service list, pricing, staff list, and the tablet or computer used at the front desk.

1. Update your salon information

From the left menu, select POS (the point-of-sale screen), then Salon Settings and Salon Information.

Update your salon name, address, phone number, email, and business hours.

You are done when: Your contact information and business hours are correct.

2. Add services

Open the Services tab. Add each service name, price, and duration.

You are done when: At least one service is active.

3. Add staff

Open the Staff tab. Add each staff member, then assign services and a work schedule.

You are done when: At least one staff member is ready to accept appointments.

4. Test appointment booking

Open Booking and create a test appointment.

You are done when: The appointment shows the correct date, time, service, and staff member.

5. Check the checkout screen

Open POS and check the service, tip, and payment options. Connect a receipt printer or card reader if your salon uses one.

You are done when: The checkout screen is ready to use.

6. Complete a test transaction

  1. Create a customer.
  2. Create an appointment.
  3. Check in the customer to confirm they have arrived.
  4. Complete the service.
  5. Check out and complete the payment.

You are done when: The transaction and receipt are recorded correctly.

Your salon is ready

Your salon can begin operating after you can complete this flow:

Book an appointment → Customer arrives → Complete the service → Check out → Take payment

Customer self check-in, reviews, messaging, and AI Voice can be set up later.

If something does not work

  • Cannot create an appointment: Check the salon hours, staff schedule, and service duration.
  • Cannot find a staff member: Check their status, assigned services, and work schedule.
  • Cannot check out: Confirm that the ticket has a service and an available payment method.

title: Set Up Your Salon Information and Business Hours
summary: Add accurate contact information and business hours so customers can book at the right times.
htmlContent:
Add your contact information and business hours so customers can book only when your salon is open.

Before you start

Prepare your salon name, address, phone number, email, logo, and opening hours for each day.

1. Open Salon Information

From the left menu, select POS (the point-of-sale screen), then Salon Settings and Salon Information.

2. Update your salon information

Select the edit icon, then check your salon name, address, phone number, email, and logo. Select Save when finished.

3. Update your business hours

In Business Hours, select the edit icon. For each day of the week:

  • Turn on the days your salon is open.
  • Select the opening time.
  • Select the closing time.
  • Turn off the days your salon is closed.

Select Save.

You are done when

  • Your salon contact information is correct.
  • Each workday shows the correct opening and closing time.
  • Closed days appear as closed.
  • You can select a valid time when creating a test appointment.

If something does not work

Business hours will not save

Make sure the closing time is later than the opening time and every open day has both times.

Appointment times look incorrect

Check the time zone used by your salon.

Customers cannot book a certain day

Check whether that day is closed or whether the selected time is outside business hours.

Tip

After changing business hours, review appointments already scheduled during the affected time.

title: Add Services, Pricing, and Durations
summary: Create the services customers can book and staff can add during checkout.
htmlContent:
Create your service list so customers can book services and staff can select them during checkout.

Before you start

Prepare each service name, price, duration, and category, such as manicures, pedicures, or waxing.

1. Open the service list

From the left menu, select POS (the point-of-sale screen), then Salon Settings and Services.

2. Create service categories

Select Manage Categories if your salon does not have service categories yet. Add each category name, arrange the categories in the preferred order, and save.

3. Add a service

Select Add Service, then enter:

  • Service name.
  • Price.
  • Duration.
  • An optional description.
  • At least one service category.

4. Make the service available

Turn on Active so the service can be used, then select Save.

You are done when

  • The service appears in the list.
  • The price and duration are correct.
  • The service is in the correct category.
  • The service status is active.

If something does not work

The service will not save

Make sure the name, price, duration, and category have been entered.

The service does not appear during booking

Make sure the service is active and assigned to at least one staff member.

A category cannot be deleted

Move or remove the services in that category before deleting it.

Tips

  • Start with your salon's most popular services.
  • Use short names so staff can find services quickly during checkout.
  • Use realistic durations to help prevent overlapping appointments.

title: Add Staff and Set Work Schedules
summary: Add staff, assign the services they provide, and set the hours when they can accept appointments.
htmlContent:
Add each staff member, choose the services they can provide, and set their work hours so they can accept appointments.

Before you start

Prepare the staff member's name, phone number or email, service list, and weekly work schedule.

1. Open the staff list

From the left menu, select POS (the point-of-sale screen), then Salon Settings and Staff.

2. Add a staff member

Select Add Staff, then choose the option that fits:

  • Link a staff member who already has a NEXORA account.
  • Invite a staff member to create an account.
  • Create a salon-only profile if the staff member does not need a NEXORA account yet.

3. Open the staff profile

Find the staff member you added and select View & Edit.

4. Choose access and payment settings

In Role, Pay & Tip, select the role that matches the staff member's work, then save.

5. Assign services

In Service Assignment, select specific services, all services in a category, or all available salon services. Select Save Services.

6. Set the work schedule

In Weekly Work Schedule:

  • Turn on the days the staff member works.
  • Select the start and end time.
  • Mark days off when needed.

Select Save Schedule.

You are done when

  • The staff member appears in the staff list.
  • Their role is saved.
  • At least one service is assigned.
  • The work schedule shows the correct days and hours.
  • You can select the staff member in a test appointment.

If something does not work

The staff account cannot be found

Check the Staff ID, phone number, or email. Send an invitation if the staff member does not have an account.

Services or schedules cannot be assigned

Save Role, Pay & Tip first, then try again.

The staff member does not appear during booking

Make sure the staff member is active, has the service assigned, and is scheduled to work at the selected time.

Tip

If a staff member provides every service, select All Services for faster setup. Review the assignment after adding new services.

title: Set Up Online Booking
summary: Choose how customers can book online and create a test appointment before sharing your booking link.
htmlContent:
Choose how customers book online and create a test appointment before your salon begins using online booking.

Before you start

Make sure your salon has business hours, at least one active service, and at least one staff member with assigned services and a work schedule.

1. Open Booking Settings

From the left menu, select POS (the point-of-sale screen), then Salon Settings and Salon Information. Find Booking Settings.

2. Choose how appointments are confirmed

Turn on Automatically confirm online bookings if you want online appointments confirmed immediately. Turn it off if the salon should review each appointment first.

3. Set booking time limits

Update:

  • Minimum notice: How far in advance a customer must book.
  • Maximum advance booking: How many days ahead a customer can book.
  • Appointment reminder: How many hours before the appointment a reminder is sent.

4. Choose who receives notifications

If your salon uses booking messages, select who should receive notifications: the customer, the salon, and the assigned staff member.

5. Save your settings

Select Save and review the values you entered.

6. Create a test appointment

Open Booking and select New Appointment. Enter the customer's name and phone number, date and time, service, and staff member. Select Create Appointment.

You are done when

  • Your booking settings are saved.
  • The test appointment appears at the correct date and time.
  • The service and staff member are correct.
  • The appointment is confirmed or waiting for salon confirmation, based on your setting.

If something does not work

No appointment time is available

Check the salon's business hours, the staff schedule, and the service duration.

No staff member is available

Make sure the staff member is active, assigned to the service, and scheduled at the selected time.

The appointment is too soon

Select a later time or reduce the minimum notice if that works for your salon.

The appointment is too far away

Select an earlier date or increase the maximum advance booking period.

The time overlaps another appointment

Select another staff member or time.

Tip

Create several test appointments before sharing the online booking link with customers.
